To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The plaza of the case study is used by the people of the neighborhood as a space for walking and for getting from one point to another, and 2) the space does not seem to be very attractive for other types of uses, such as playing, resting or having social gatherings.
the space is used by people in a way that is not very attractive to them, and that the space itself is not attractive to them either.
the public plaza is used mainly as a means to get from point A to point B.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the articulators of public space through a semiotic analysis based on walks and uses (traces) that leave the subject or actant during its daily use of this place.
the study of the space of the public place and the way in which it is appropriated by its users through their everyday activities.

the analysis of the public space, and how the users of this space, interact, use and appropriate it, through the semiotic analysis based on routes and uses (footprints of appropriation) that the subject or actant leaves during its daily use of this site.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, the space studied, does not have enough elements to attract the attention of the users, and that the space is not attractive for the users, and the space does not allow or promote ludic or resting or convivial activities, since the observed space is apparently not attractive for those purposes.
the space studied, is used for walking, to move from point A to point B, and/or on a bicycle.

the plaza is used by the actors of the city as a space of movement, a place that allows the actors of the neighborhood to move from one place to another, without the need to use the vehicular traffic, and that the plaza has the ability to be a place of meeting, but it does not have the ability to be the place for meeting, as there is no equipment or furniture that would allow this type of activity to be carried out.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified ten different uses of the public space, which we call semas, and that we have identified the elements which are part of the space, which we called semes.
we are interested in understanding the relationship between the individual and the city, through the analysis of a public space.
the city is a place where people live, and where they interact with each other and with the space that surrounds them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have found that the plaza is used for walking and biking, and is not used for other activities.
we are able to identify the elements that articulate public space, through semiotic analysis of the walks and uses (appropriation traces) that the subject leaves in the use of this site.
the public spaces are not being used as a whole, but rather in parts, and the main activity that is being performed is walking.
